title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-11-08
lineage: MR (Dick Latvala) > DAT > SoundForge (Jim Wise) > CD

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a solid ’69 show with sweet‑sloppy playing, highlighted by Uncle John’s Band, Main Ten and an inspired China Cat > Rider jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard (SBD) sourced from Dick’s 16 tapes and sounds clean enough for most listeners; no major audio flaws are reported. Musically the concert sits in the middle of the ’69 era – the first set is described as average, but the second half delivers memorable moments such as Uncle John’s Band, a rare Main Ten jam and an exciting China Cat > Rider sequence. Overall fans view it positively, though one reviewer rates it only three stars for being an unremarkable example of its year.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews and one moderate 3‑star review give an average of ~4.3; weighting show quality heavily still yields a strong rating despite mixed comments on set uniqueness.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Soundboard (SBD) from Dick's 16 tapes; reviewers note it sounds clear with no specific drop‑outs, though one mentions the tape was completed from existing sources and some material (the Rider) is missing.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as typical and tentative for 1969, while the second half (or continuous second‑set-like segment) delivers tighter jams and highlights, making the concert more appealing to fans of that era.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar is noted as tentative early in the show but shows promising phrasing and contributes strongly to the jam sections.
